width_rule: wg_width set to single_mode_width_um=1.2 and io_width raised to 0.5 so all feature widths respect min_feature_um=0.5.
physics_rule: FSR_nm = wavelength_um^2 * 1000 / (n_g * delta_length_um); at 1.55 um and 8.0 nm target, delta_length_target_um = 300.3125 / n_g.

iterations.reasoning: Initial TFLN evaluation with wg_width=1.2 and min-feature-safe io_width=0.5 shows the recreated 10.5 um imbalance is too short. From FSR=lambda^2/(n_g*delta_L), the target imbalance is delta_L=300.3125/2.2277374267578125=134.80605765871903 um. I will set the top-level delta_length to that value so the longer lower gf.Path arm physically realizes the needed optical-path imbalance.

The TFLN imbalance converged. The measured lower-arm excess is 134.806 um, and the FSR predicted by 1.55^2*1000/(2.2277374267578125*134.806) is 8.000003421730131 nm, inside tolerance. No further geometry move is needed.

final_raster.note: Rasterized optimized GDS against the original image calibration after spec convergence; IoU drop is expected because the lower arm was lengthened to meet FSR.
